name: Tor-Proxy
description: Tor Proxy runs the Tor network daemon as a SOCKS5 proxy in a container, so other apps can route explicitly configured outbound traffic through Tor.

paths.name: Tor Data
paths.description: Persistent Tor data directory, including cached relay state and keys if you add relay or onion-service configuration.

ports.name: SOCKS5 Port
ports.description: Tor SOCKS5 proxy port. Container port: 9050.

variables.name: SOCKS Hostname
variables.description: Interface Tor listens on inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 for Unraid bridge networking and other containers.

variables.name: SOCKS Port
variables.description: SOCKS port Tor listens on inside the container. Keep this aligned with the container port mapping.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Tor log level, for example err, warn, notice, info, or debug.

variables.name: Debug
variables.description: Enable wrapper debug output for troubleshooting. Use true or false.

variables.name: Set Permissions
variables.description: Allow the container wrapper to chown/chmod the Tor data directory at startup. Keep false on Unraid if you see Operation not permitted on /var/lib/tor.

variables.name: Torrc Append
variables.description: Optional raw torrc lines appended to the generated configuration. Use for advanced relay, bridge, onion service, or isolation settings only after checking Tor documentation.
